title: Exponential Function: Finding the Equation
body:
An exponential function $f(x) = a \cdot b^x + q$ has a horizontal asymptote at $y = -2$ and passes through the points $(0, 1)$ and $(1, 4)$.

a) Determine the value of $q$.
b) Find the values of $a$ and $b$.
